drums.description: Progressive house track at 128 BPM in the key of G minor, The arrangement features a prominent, syncopated sub-bass line that interacts with a sidechained white noise riser and a four-on-the-floor kick drum, A bright, sawtooth lead synth plays a repetitive, rhythmic motif with a short decay and high-pass filter automation, Layered over the percussion are crisp, high-frequency closed hi-hats on the eighth-note offbeats and a sharp clap on beats two and four, A secondary FM synth pluck provides melodic counterpoint with a dotted-eighth-note delay effect, The track utilizes frequent filter sweeps and snare rolls to build tension before melodic drops, Atmospheric pads with long release times provide harmonic depth in the background Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 135 BPM in 4/4 time, A resonant, syncopated synth bassline with a short decay provides the melodic foundation, High-frequency percussion includes a metallic, ringing closed hi-hat on every eighth note and a sharp, noise-based snare on beats 2 and 4, A dark, filtered sawtooth lead synth enters with a repetitive four-bar minor-key motif, Periodic industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and white noise sweeps, are processed with short room reverb, The track features a breakdown where the kick drum filters out, leaving a pulsing sub-bass and a rhythmic, gated synth pad before a high-pass filter sweep leads into the drop Publish
